entry_points.summary: Build resolved config from all 4 layers; returns (values, sources) dicts
Print export lines for all user knobs; emit config_resolved event once per run
Resolve and print single dotted-key value; exits 3 on unknown key
Write global config with defaults + inline comments if absent; never overwrites
Print effective value and source layer for one key
Print yes|no for a given event kind; always exits 0; exits 2 on unknown event
Built-in default values for all config keys (layer 1)
Allowed enum sets per dotted-key; drives hard-fail on repo/env, soft-warn on global
Thin bash wrapper: exec python3 scripts/config.py $@

invariants: ensure-defaults never writes repo-local; only writes the global user path
should-notify always exits 0 on valid event kind (yes|no on stdout); exits 2 on unknown event
config_resolved event emitted at most once per $Z_HARNESS_RUN via O_EXCL temp-file de-dup
enum: notify.level in {off, approval_only, all}; docs.always_apply in {always, never}
transliteration rule: dotted.key -> Z_HARNESS_<SECTION>_<KEY> (uppercase, dot to underscore)
keys must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*\.[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$; hyphens or >2-level nesting exit 2
empty env vars are treated as missing (not as override)
unknown keys in TOML files are silently ignored for forward compatibility
global-layer enum violations: soft-warn + fall back to default; repo/env-layer violations: exit 2
gotchas: Global config validation is soft (warn + default fallback); repo/env config validation is hard (exit 2) — same bad value has different outcomes depending on which file it appears in
docs.always_apply=never only suppresses doc-fetcher in light flows (/z-do); heavy flows always dispatch doc-fetcher regardless
Z_HARNESS_REPO_CONFIG env var overrides git-root discovery entirely — exits 2 if path does not exist
ensure-defaults exits 4 (not 2) on I/O errors and when file exists but is empty or unparseable; it never silently overwrites
scripts/config.sh is only a 2-line exec wrapper — all logic lives in config.py
providers-registry is NOT a dependency; it was listed in the old compact schema in error
